production.note: US model years 2025 to present. First: PCNA: 'The new 2025 911 Carrera is available to order now as a Coupe or Cabriolet with rear-wheel drive' ('Deliveries of the new 2025 911 Carrera models to U.S. Porsche Centers are expected to start in the fall'). Still on sale: the Canadian Car of the Year 2026 finalist page (ccoty-2026-911-carrera) says 'The Porsche 911 Carrera enters the 2026 model year with a number of important changes' (Canadian market). No US page for a 2026 or later 911 Carrera was opened.

body.note: 'available to order now as a Coupe or Cabriolet with rear-wheel drive'. The Cabriolet is the open version of the same variant.

configuration.note: 'a 3.0 liter twin-turbo boxer engine'; C/D panel: 'twin-turbocharged and intercooled DOHC 24-valve flat-6'.

displacementL.note: 2,981 cc (C/D panel: 'Displacement: 182 in3, 2981 cm3'); PCNA: '3.0 liter'.

aspiration.note: '3.0 liter twin-turbo boxer engine'; 'The turbochargers of the new 911 Carrera were adopted from the previous 911 Carrera GTS models.'

fuel.note: Inferred from the panel's description ('direct fuel injection' gasoline flat-6); unlike the GTS, the Carrera has no hybrid system.

drivetrain.note: 'Coupe or Cabriolet with rear-wheel drive'; Carrera 4 models are separate.

transmission.note: C/D panel: '8-speed dual-clutch automatic'. PCNA's release names no manual for the 992.2 Carrera; it says 'Both powertrains are fitted with PDK as standard.' DCT is Porsche PDK.

powerHp.note: Quote: "With these modifications, the new 911 Carrera now makes 290 kW (388 hp)". C/D panel (cd-2025-911-carrera): "Power: 388 hp @ 6500 rpm".

weightLb.note: 2025 coupe with the 8-speed PDK (only transmission). Car and Driver road-test curb weight (owner decision 9 October 2026: accepted at weight step 2; it is the measured test car). Quote: "Curb Weight: 3472 lb". The test car was optioned (as tested $148,515 vs base $122,095). PCNA's release opened gives no curb weight for the Carrera; no Porsche US figure was found.
